# Batted-ball result sequence

The terminal batted-ball motion and fair-ball classification precede the plate-appearance result, which is contained in the batted-ball play.

This view shows the ontology pattern without MLB JSON paths or RML machinery.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    N01["Result"]
    N02["Batted Ball Motion"]
    N03["Batted Ball Play"]
    N04["Fair Ball"]
    N02 -->|precedes| N01
    N03 -->|has occurrent part| N01
    N03 -->|has occurrent part| N04
    N04 -->|precedes| N01
```
